note: Cheating probes for scripts/frontier-v5/probe_verifier.py: edits to the unfixed base artifact that try to score without fixing anything. Every probe must score 0. See docs/frontier-v5/PHASE1.md, 'Verifier audit 2026-10-08'.

probes.name: exit-stealth
probes.why: a static initializer in a graded source calling _exit(0) through a function pointer, evading the scan: every test process exits 0 before tut or the XML tester prints a result, so cases must come out failed or missing, not passed

probes.name: summary-forge
probes.why: a static initializer that reads the group from the command line, prints an assembled group line and 'tests summary: ok:1', then exits 0 through a function pointer, evading the scan. The one-summary and group-line checks do not stop it (every unit case reads as passed); the must-fail unit sentinel does (it reads as passed too, so sentinel=0), and the XML held-out cases still fail because the XML tester's first argument is an option

probes.name: tut-plant
probes.why: a planted tut/tut.hpp under src that no-ops ensure(); it is not a .cpp or .h file, so the verifier never copies it, src is not on the tests' include path, and the tamper scan flags the new tut directory
